newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian National trains stopped by B.C. blizzard.
newsitem.headline: Canadian National trains stopped by B.C. blizzard.

text.p: Canadian National Railway Co trains were at a standstill after more than a foot of snow fell on British Columbia's southwest coast, a Canadian Wheat Board spokesman said.
"CN's at a complete standstill on the west coast and we haven't heard from CP (Rail Systems) yet. Shipping for us is continuing, we've got good stocks at the ports," CWB spokesman Jim Pietryk said.
Spokesmen for CN and CP had yet to return calls.
The blizzard dumped 34 cm (13.5 inches) of snow on Vancouver in the 24-hour period ended Sunday evening.
